scope: 全文可访问并核对相关方法段，不表示逐定理复证或实验复现；摘要条目不得被写成已精读全文。

entries.title: Nota & Thomas, Is the Policy Gradient a Gradient?
entries.supports: 外层折扣省略与起点折扣目标不等价；不能据此要求所有实现必须加权，也不能称去权仍无偏。

entries.title: Stable-Baselines3 PPO source
entries.supports: clipped surrogate使用mean而无episode-prefix权重；不据此声称它原生支持本项目GRU/动态候选/SMDP。

entries.title: Ståhlberg, Bonet & Geffner, Learning General Policies with Policy Gradient Methods
entries.supports: GNN state-transition classifier与策略梯度/actor-critic；arXiv2512.19366是后续deposit，不把编号年份当会议年份。

entries.title: Counterfactual Quotient Models: Learning What Actions Change, Not What the World Does
entries.supports: 行动间中心化的未来量/同步反事实rollout目标；不是本项目prior×nominal编码2×2；其定理不移植。

entries.title: Yan et al., Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Model Priors
entries.supports: 状态条件化动作先验p(a|s)参与KL/采样/Q；不能称为状态不变static prior。

entries.title: Guiding Reinforcement Learning Using Uncertainty-Aware Large Language Models
entries.supports: MC dropout与动态熵调节guidance，并涉及LLM定制/微调；不是本项目固定图对照。

entries.title: Large Language Model as a Policy Teacher for Training Reinforcement Learning Agents / LLM4Teach
entries.supports: 不完美teacher软动作指导/蒸馏与衰减；不作四视图结构交互。

entries.title: The Mechanism Matters: When Knowledge Graphs Help Reinforcement Learning
entries.supports: 比较feature/mask/shaping及KG质量；有限实验或最优策略不变性不证明本项目坏prior无害。

entries.title: Leveraging Approximate Symbolic Models for Reinforcement Learning via Skill Diversity / ASGRL
entries.supports: 近似符号模型、landmarks、技能多样性；不完美符号知识+RL是已有设定。

entries.title: Subgoal Graph-Augmented Planning for LLM-Guided Open-World Reinforcement Learning
entries.supports: 子目标图与critique/refinement路径，与固定源关系使用不同。

entries.title: Leveraging Pre-trained Large Language Models to Construct and Utilize World Models for Model-based Task Planning
entries.supports: 显式规划模型构造、验证/修正、规划；非本项目软关系残差。

entries.title: InterPreT: Interactive Predicate Learning from Language Feedback for Generalizable Task Planning
entries.supports: 根据交互语言反馈学习谓词与动作模型；不是冻结关系决策利用。

entries.title: UniDomain: Pretraining a Unified PDDL Domain from Real-World Demonstrations for Generalizable Robot Task Planning
entries.supports: 从示范学习/构造可复用PDDL domain，与soft message edges不同。

entries.title: Vision-Language Models Provide Promptable Representations for Reinforcement Learning / PR2L
entries.supports: 本轮独立补充；VLM提供语义表示，由RL学其用途，因此非动作指令式VLM+RL并非新领域。

entries.title: Set Transformer: A Framework for Attention-based Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks
entries.supports: SAB/MAB/PMA集合注意力与置换性质；本项目仅使用标准两层SAB+candidate query适配。

entries.title: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
entries.supports: GAE/TD(lambda)偏差方差取舍；one-step并非普遍偏差最小。

entries.title: Reinforcement Learning with Unsupervised Auxiliary Tasks / UNREAL
entries.supports: 共享表示的辅助任务是已有原则；并非声称本Q严格复现UNREAL。

entries.title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control
entries.supports: 本轮独立补充；既有控制+学习残差，区别在本项目logit界与交互输入。

entries.title: Modeling Relational Data with Graph Convolutional Networks
entries.supports: 关系权重共享、basis与aggregation；不是对当前task门控的证明。

entries.title: Phasic Policy Gradient
entries.supports: 辅助阶段与特征共享干扰的背景；未据摘要细节证明当前lambda=0.1无风险。

entries.title: Time Limits in Reinforcement Learning
entries.supports: 终止与时间限制处理背景；本项目具体flag定义由规范负责。

entries.title: Planning with Learned Object Importance in Large Problem Instances using GNNs / PLOI
entries.supports: 对象重要性筛选，不是直接候选后继策略的同义工作。

entries.title: LLM+P: Empowering Large Language Models with Optimal Planning Proficiency
entries.supports: 自然语言到规划问题/外部planner；不把全部LLM-PDDL都概括为学习新的动作模型。

entries.title: Graph Learning for Planning: The Story Thus Far and Open Challenges
entries.supports: 只作综述导航，不以综述取代原创论文核验。

entries.title: Afterstate RL for Continuous Control（Claude给出的条目）
entries.supports: 访问返回浏览器验证页，本轮未独立确认该题目/作者/正文，不作为已确认核心依据。
